arabic text: TABUTE HASSAN KA HAI AUR KHUn ME NAHAYA HAI
english translation text: This is Hasan’s bier, drenched in blood.

arabic text: DIL FAATEMA ZEHRAA KAA YE KISNE DUKHAYAA HAI
english translation text: Who has caused such pain to Fatima Zahra’s heart?

arabic text: KAT KAT KE GIRE TUKDE MAULA KE JIGAR KE\nQASIM KO SHAHADAT KA ANDAAZ BATAYA HAI
english translation text: The pieces of the Maula’s liver fell one by\none; he showed Qasim the manner of martyrdom.

arabic text: MAULA KE JANAAZE PAR BAARISH NAHIn TEERO KI\nYE AJRE RISAALAT HAI UMMAAT NE CHUKAAYA HAI
english translation text: Arrows rained upon the Maula’s funeral. This is\nhow the nation repaid the Prophet’s mission.

arabic text: LO KARBOBALA KAA AB AAGHAAZ HUWA LOGO\nMAHAUL MUHARRAM KA SHABBAR NE MANAAYA HAI
english translation text: People, the beginning of Karbala has now\nappeared; Shabbar created the atmosphere of Muharram.

arabic text: AI MAULA HASSAN ISKO KAFAN BHI NA MILEGA\nSHABBIR NE MAYYAT KO KAANDHE PE UTHAAYA HAI
english translation text: O Maula Hasan, he too will receive no\nshroud; Shabbir carried the body upon his shoulders.

arabic text: ZAINAB TERI JEE BHAR KAR PHIR DEKHLE BHAI KO\nTAABUT HASSAN KAA YUn GHAR LOUT KE AAYAA HAI
english translation text: Zainab, look your fill upon your brother once more;\nHasan’s bier has returned home in this state.

arabic text: RAIHAAN QAYAAMAT ME DOZAKH UNhE DhUNDhEGI\nDIL FAATEMAZAHRAA KA JIS JIS NE DUKHAAYAA HAI
english translation text: Rehan, on the Day of Judgement, Hell will seek\nevery person who caused pain to Fatima Zahra’s heart.
